title: The Healthcare Paradox — Official Trailer: Five-Star Care. Two-Star Payments.
description: A board-certified cardiologist who is not leaving Puerto Rico: same Medicare payroll tax, benchmarks about 40% below the national average and 20% below the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Medicare's own ratings showing five-star care. One solution for Secretary Kennedy: a 0.70 minimum AGA floor across Puerto Rico for 2028, using existing administrative authority. Act now. Listen to The Healthcare Paradox. New episodes are out now on Amazon Music, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, iHeartRadio, and YouTube.
